trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Identified the issue:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in production; the most recent previously healthy release was **v2.3.0**.
- **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollback confirmed rolled out.
- **Verified recovery:** the service now reports healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions, with an error rate of 0.002.
- **Opened SEV2 incident** INC-0001 ("checkout-api failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which has paged the on-call engineer. It notes the failing v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback action and target version, and the need to investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure.
